description: Thinkpond is a fast, minimal idea forum. Post an idea, vote on the ones you like, and discuss. Browse a clean feed of community ideas, share your own, and watch the best ones rise to the top.
promotionalText: Post an idea, vote on the good ones, argue about the rest. A fast feed where the best ideas rise on their own.
whatsNew: Sparkjar is now Thinkpond. New name, new firefly-in-a-jar icon, and a cleaner look with one warm accent colour. Also a daily idea notification at 9am and a steadier tab bar.
